skill.name: brag
skill.description: Create a short launch video from the current website or app project using Hyperframes. The skill analyzes local project files, plans scenes, renders video, and writes share copy.
skill.summary: Turn a local website or app project into a polished launch video with coordinated visuals, audio, and share copy.
skill.author: latent-spaces

security_audit.summary: All 90 static findings are contextual false positives caused by media terminology, Markdown formatting, bounded skill-asset paths, and fixed output paths. No prompt injection, keylogging, credential access, data exfiltration, or unsafe dynamic command construction was found. The expected workflow reads local project files, writes generated media, and invokes Hyperframes and ffmpeg.

content.value_statement: Turning a project into a concise launch video requires product analysis, scripting, animation, audio, and rendering. Brag coordinates that workflow with Hyperframes and delivers a video, poster, storyboard, and share copy.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes local project files to identify product claims, visual identity, assets, and the main user flow.
Creates a 15 to 25 second storyboard with a selected tone, format, pacing, scenes, and readable copy.
Selects bundled music and sound effects, with optional beat synchronization and audio-reactive guidance.
Builds and validates a Hyperframes composition, then renders an MP4 and extracts a poster frame.
Writes a concise, tone-matched caption for sharing the finished project video.
limitations: Requires Hyperframes and local media tools, including ffmpeg for poster extraction and final video processing.
Works from local project source files and does not inspect a deployed website automatically.
Voice narration is disabled by default and uses the Kokoro workflow only when explicitly requested.
Output quality depends on the source project having clear copy, visuals, or a demonstrable user flow.

use_cases.title: Launch an Indie Project
use_cases.description: Turn a working app into a concise video that demonstrates its strongest interaction and produces ready-to-share launch copy.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Product Announcement
use_cases.description: Create a polished vertical or landscape product video that follows brand colors, typography, claims, and campaign tone.

use_cases.title: Present a Design Prototype
use_cases.description: Translate interface source files into a storyboard and animated composition that highlights a realistic user flow.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Launch Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a polished launch video for this project. Keep it near 20 seconds and show the main user flow.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a first video with sensible defaults.

prompt_templates.title: Make a Vertical Product Video
prompt_templates.prompt: /brag --tone polished --format vertical --duration 20. Focus on the strongest product interaction and keep every text scene readable.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a vertical social media announcement.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Cinematic Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: /brag --tone cinematic --format landscape. Use restrained sound effects, subtle audio-reactive motion, and a strong final product reveal.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when pacing, audio, and visual emphasis need explicit direction.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Narrated Campaign Cut
prompt_templates.prompt: /brag --tone "quiet premium product film" --format square --duration 24 --voice --title "Project Atlas". Center the story on entry, key action, and result.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this advanced prompt for custom direction, narration, format, duration, and title.

output: A 20-second vertical product video with a restrained visual treatment and readable feature scenes.
A selected poster frame that shows the strongest settled product moment.
A concise caption aligned with the project's real value proposition.

output_examples.input: Create a cinematic launch video with narration for this app.
output: A storyboard built around the app's entry, key action, and result.
A cinematic composition with opt-in narration, music, restrained sound effects, and synchronized visual emphasis.
A rendered video, poster image, composition brief, and share caption.
A fast launch video that uses energetic motion while preserving readable text.
A sound design plan without music that uses only purposeful interface and impact effects.

best_practices: Use a project with clear product copy, brand styles, and a demonstrable user flow.
Specify format, tone, duration, and audio preferences when campaign requirements are fixed.
Review the local Hyperframes preview before requesting the final high-quality render.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill when local project files contain secrets that the agent should not inspect.
Do not force rapid text changes that leave viewers insufficient reading time.
Do not replace real product interactions with generic claims when a working user flow exists.

faq.question: Does this skill need a live website?
faq.answer: No. It reads the current local project files and uses their copy, styles, assets, and interface structure.

faq.question: Which video formats are supported?
faq.answer: It supports landscape, vertical, and square formats through the format option.

faq.question: How long is the finished video?
faq.answer: The normal target is 15 to 25 seconds, with scene timing adjusted for readability.

faq.question: Can I disable music or sound effects?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the no-music or no-sfx option, or request intentional silence in the creative direction.

faq.question: Does it support narration?
faq.answer: Yes. Narration is opt-in through the voice option and uses Kokoro through Hyperframes.

faq.question: What files does the workflow create?
faq.answer: It creates a plan, composition brief, Hyperframes composition, rendered video, poster image, and share copy inside a dedicated output directory.
